ja: 手伝ってくれた友達に頼むよ。
en: I'll ask the friend who helped me.
alternatives: I'll ask my friend who helped me.
I'll ask the friend who helped me out.
point: 人を後ろから説明する who 節

ja: 車で送らなくていいよ。
en: No need to drive me.
alternatives: You don't have to drive me.
You don't need to drive me.
point: 「〜しなくていい」は No need to / don't have to

ja: 空いてる椅子がある。
en: There's a free chair.
alternatives: One chair is available.
There's an unused chair.
point: a free chair は今使われていない椅子。

ja: 君が断ってたら、今も困ってる。
en: If you'd said no, I'd still be stuck.
alternatives: If you'd refused, I'd still be stuck.
Had you said no, I'd still be stuck.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は would be

ja: 何を手伝えばいい？
en: What can I do?
alternatives: How can I help?
What can I help with?
point: 「手伝う」は help。what で始める

ja: 代わってもらえたら、一つ借りだね。
en: If you could cover, I'd owe you one.
alternatives: If you covered for me, I'd owe you one.
If you could cover, I'd owe you big.
point: owe you one は「借りができる」。if 節は過去形

ja: ずっとお願いしたかったんだ。
en: I've been meaning to ask you.
alternatives: I've been wanting to ask you a favor.
I've been meaning to ask you something.
point: 「ずっと〜しようと」は have been meaning to

ja: できたら手伝うよ。
en: I'll help if I can.
alternatives: If I can, I'll help.
I'll help you if I can.
point: if 節の中は現在形

ja: 彼が頼むなんて、夢にも思わなかった。
en: Never would I have thought he'd ask me.
alternatives: I never imagined he'd ask me.
I'd never have thought he'd ask me.
point: Never を文頭に出すと would I の倒置

ja: もしかして、お時間ありません？
en: Would you happen to have time?
alternatives: I don't suppose you'd have a minute?
Do you happen to have a minute?
point: Would you happen to ～? で控えめに頼む

ja: 誰に聞けばいいか分かりますか？
en: Do you know who to ask?
alternatives: Could you tell me who to ask?
Do you know who I should ask?
point: 疑問詞 + to do で「誰に聞けば」

ja: 君が頼む前に私は無理してた。
en: I'd overextended myself before you asked.
alternatives: I'd already overextended myself before you asked.
I'd overdone it before you asked.
point: overextend myself は自分の余力を超えて引き受ける。

ja: 頼む相手は、彼女が知ってるかも。
en: She might know who I should ask.
alternatives: Maybe she knows who I should ask.
She may know who I ought to ask.
point: who の後は平叙文の語順

ja: 君は借りた工具を返すべき。
en: You should return borrowed tools.
alternatives: You ought to return borrowed tools.
You should give borrowed tools back.
point: borrowed tools は借りている工具。

ja: 僕を君の防波堤に使わないで。
en: Don't have me run interference for you.
alternatives: Don't use me as your shield.
Don't make me act as your buffer.
point: run interference は邪魔や圧力を引き受けて人を守る。

ja: この箱は壊れやすい。
en: This box is fragile.
alternatives: This box breaks easily.
The box is easily damaged.
point: fragile は壊れやすい。

ja: 君の負担が増えるのが心配だ。
en: I worry this increases your burden.
alternatives: I'm concerned this increases your workload.
I'm worried this increases your burden.
point: burden は相手に負担をかける動詞にもなる。

ja: 私は君の頼みを断り心苦しい。
en: I regret turning down your request.
alternatives: I feel bad about declining your request.
I'm sorry I declined your request.
point: regret doing はその行為を心苦しく思う。

ja: 彼の代わりを務めたのは、私なんだよ。
en: It was me who covered for him.
alternatives: I'm the one who covered for him.
I was the one who filled in for him.
point: cover for は「〜の代わりを務める」

ja: 手を貸せるよ。
en: I can give you a hand.
alternatives: I can lend you a hand.
I could help you out.
point: 「手を貸す」は give a hand

ja: 彼が車で送ってくれた。
en: He drove me.
alternatives: He gave me a ride.
He drove me home.
point: 「送ってくれた」は過去形で言う

ja: 彼女は口利きをすると言った。
en: She said she'd pull some strings.
alternatives: She said she'd use her influence.
She said she'd put in a word.
point: pull strings はコネや影響力を使うこと。

ja: 君が手一杯でも、手を貸して。
en: Even if you're swamped, please pitch in.
alternatives: Please help even if you're swamped.
Even if you're busy, please help.
point: pitch in は協力して手を貸すこと。

ja: 今、料理中で手が離せない。
en: I'm busy cooking right now.
alternatives: I'm in the middle of cooking.
I'm busy cooking at the moment.
point: busy の後ろは -ing(busy cooking)

ja: 私のバッグが重い。
en: My bag is heavy.
alternatives: My bag's a heavy one.
Mine's a heavy bag.
point: heavy は持ち運ぶのが大変な重さ。

ja: 悪いけど、今回は降りるしかない。
en: I'm afraid I'll have to bow out.
alternatives: Sorry, I'll have to sit this one out.
I'm afraid I have to back out.
point: 断りは bow out / back out で柔らかく

ja: ペン貸して。
en: Lend me a pen.
alternatives: Please lend me a pen.
Can I borrow a pen?
point: 「貸す」は lend、「借りる」は borrow

ja: 少しゆっくりお願いします。
en: Could you speak a little slower?
alternatives: Could you slow down a little?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
point: 「もう少し〜」は a little + 比較級

ja: 鍵がどこか、心当たりある？
en: Any idea where my key is?
alternatives: Do you know where my key is?
Any idea where I left my key?
point: 間接疑問は where + 主語 + 動詞の順

ja: 私、荷物を運んでる。
en: I'm carrying bags.
alternatives: I'm carrying the bags.
I'm moving the bags.
point: 進行形で今荷物を運んでいると伝える。

ja: 受けてたら私は今知らずに操られてる。
en: Had I agreed, I'd be an unwitting pawn.
alternatives: If I'd agreed, I'd be an unwitting pawn.
I'd be an unwitting pawn now had I agreed.
point: unwitting pawn は気づかずに他人に利用される人。

ja: 父が呼んだら私が手伝う。
en: I'll help when Dad calls.
alternatives: I'll help if Dad calls.
I'll help once Dad calls.
point: 未来の呼びかけでも when 節は現在形。

ja: 頼みは、ざっと見るだけ。
en: What I need is a quick look.
alternatives: All I need is a quick look.
What I'm asking for is a quick look.
point: What I need is ~ で頼みの中心を強調

ja: 私はずっと頼みをさばいてる。
en: I've been fielding requests.
alternatives: I've been dealing with requests.
I've been handling people's requests.
point: field requests は寄せられる頼みに対応する。

ja: 充電器ってある？
en: Is there a charger?
alternatives: Do you have a charger?
Got a charger?
point: 「ある？」は Is there 〜?

ja: 頼んだ件、もう見てくれた？
en: Have you checked it yet?
alternatives: Did you check it yet?
Have you looked at it yet?
point: 「もう〜した？」は現在完了 + yet

ja: 彼に手加減してと頼んで。
en: Ask him to go easy.
alternatives: Ask him to ease up.
Ask him to be less demanding.
point: go easy は厳しさを和らげる。

ja: ちょっとこれ持ってて。
en: Hold this for a second.
alternatives: Just hold this for a second, please.
Hold this for me a sec.
point: 頼みの命令文は please で和らぐ

ja: ちょっとカバンを預かってくれる？
en: Could you hang on to my bag?
alternatives: Can you hold on to my bag?
Could you keep an eye on my bag?
point: 預かるは hang on to / hold on to

ja: 先に別の人に頼まれてたの。
en: Someone else had asked me first.
alternatives: I'd already been asked by someone else.
Someone else had already asked me.
point: 断る理由の「先に」は過去完了

ja: 誰が手伝ってくれる？
en: Who will help me?
alternatives: Who can help me?
Who's going to help me?
point: who が主語のときは倒置しない

ja: 言ってくれたら、手伝ったのに。
en: If you'd asked, I'd have helped.
alternatives: I'd have helped if you'd asked.
Had you asked, I'd have helped.
point: 過去の仮定は if + 過去完了、would have + 過去分詞

ja: ミカは私の頼みを忘れたかも。
en: Mika might have forgotten my request.
alternatives: Maybe Mika forgot what I asked her.
Mika may have forgotten my request.
point: 過去の可能性は might have + 過去分詞

ja: 彼に頼んで送ってもらった。
en: I got him to drive me.
alternatives: I asked him to drive me.
I got him to take me.
point: get 人 to do は説得して〜してもらう。have は to なし

ja: ちょっとお願いがあるの。
en: I need a favor.
alternatives: I have a favor to ask.
I'd like to ask a favor.
point: 「お願い」は a favor

ja: 私はもう君への貸しを超えて頼んだ。
en: I've already overdrawn my favor account with you.
alternatives: I've already asked more than you owe me.
I've called in more favors than you owed.
point: overdraw は貸しの残高以上に頼むという比喩。

ja: あの子守の頼みは重荷に感じる。
en: That request for babysitting feels onerous.
alternatives: That babysitting request feels burdensome.
That request for babysitting feels burdensome.
point: for babysitting は request の説明、onerous は負担が重い。

ja: 頼みを断ることは、めったにないんだ。
en: Rarely do I turn down a request.
alternatives: I rarely turn down a request.
I hardly ever say no to a request.
point: Rarely を前に出すと主語と助動詞が倒置

ja: 私も君に恩返しできたらな。
en: I wish I could reciprocate.
alternatives: I wish I could repay your kindness.
If only I could return the favor.
point: reciprocate は受けた好意を返すこと。

ja: 仕事に追われて手伝えないんだ。
en: Swamped with work, I can't help.
alternatives: Being swamped at work, I can't help.
I'm swamped with work, so I can't help.
point: Swamped は「手一杯」。分詞構文で理由を添える

ja: 手伝ってと頼まれたよ。
en: I was asked to help.
alternatives: Someone asked me to help.
They asked me to help.
point: 「頼まれた」は was asked to

ja: 私は君を車で送れる。
en: I can drive you.
alternatives: I can give you a ride.
I can take you by car.
point: drive you は車で相手を送る。

ja: 軽い方の箱を運んで。
en: Carry the lighter box.
alternatives: Take the lighter box.
Move the lighter box.
point: lighter は二つなどを比べて軽い方。

ja: 私は彼女を手伝った。
en: I helped her.
alternatives: I gave her some help.
I helped her out.
point: helped は help の過去形。

ja: 消しゴム借りるね。
en: I'll borrow your eraser.
alternatives: Let me borrow your eraser.
I'm borrowing your eraser.
point: 借りるのは borrow、貸すのは lend。その場の決定は I'll
